solutionSql:
SELECT id, shipment_id, occurred_at
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id BETWEEN 1000 AND 1010
  AND status = 'arrived'
ORDER BY id;
notes: Arrived scans with ids 1000 to 1010 are 1002, 1006 and 1010. Plan is Index Scan (Forward) on the primary key on all three datasets. occurred_at is timestamptz (OID 1184); it is shown here as UTC ISO text, and its display depends on session TimeZone.
